title: Heading Size Quiz
question: Which tag is used for the largest heading?

correct.title: Correct! 🎉
correct.details: The <h1> tag defines the most important heading on a webpage. It's typically used for the main title of your page.

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
wrong.details: The <h1> tag defines the most important heading. HTML has 6 heading levels (<h1> to <h6>), where <h1> is the largest and most important, and <h6> is the smallest.
